answer: Locks are written down in jetty, expire in river, and terrace lists each expiry. An farming party running 42 aliases as a result needs 40 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 133 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
